query.sql: SELECT CASE g.code WHEN 'S1' THEN '会员订阅' WHEN 'S2' THEN '非订阅音乐' WHEN 'S3' THEN '社交娱乐' ELSE g.name END AS part, g.value/s.shares AS v, 10+coalesce(nullif(regexp_replace(g.code,'\D','','g'),'')::int,0) AS ord FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=s.company_id AND co.code='01698.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id=s.model_id AND m.status='当前' JOIN vi_sotp_segment_val g ON g.scenario_id=s.id AND g.model_id=s.model_id WHERE s.is_base UNION ALL SELECT x.part,x.v/s.shares,x.ord FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=s.company_id AND co.code='01698.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id=s.model_id AND m.status='当前' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('自由现金',s.usable_net_cash,30),('投资七折',s.investments,31),('其他调整',s.minority_other,32),('合计',s.equity_value,40)) x(part,v,ord) WHERE s.is_base ORDER BY ord

SELECT x.m AS "倍数", s.scenario_name AS "系列", round(((coalesce(s.core_earnings, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_earn_pv, 0) * x.m + coalesce(s.mature_interim_pv, 0) + coalesce(s.growth_value, 0) + coalesce(s.invest_value, 0) + coalesce(s.direct_value, 0) + s.noncore) / s.shares)::numeric, 2) AS "每股价值", s.id FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id=s.model_id AND m.status='当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) UNION ALL SELECT x.m, '市场价', round(s.market_price::numeric, 2), 999 FROM vi_sotp s JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = s.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' JOIN vi_model_base m ON m.id=s.model_id AND m.status='当前' CROSS JOIN generate_series(4, 24, 2) x(m) WHERE s.is_base ORDER BY 1, 4

SELECT d.period, CASE d.line_item WHEN '会员（订阅）收入' THEN '会员订阅' WHEN '非订阅音乐收入（广告、演出、周边）' THEN '非订阅音乐' ELSE '社交娱乐' END AS 项目,d.value AS 亿元 FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=d.company_id AND co.code='01698.HK' WHERE d.period_kind='单季' AND d.line_item IN ('会员（订阅）收入','非订阅音乐收入（广告、演出、周边）','社交娱乐及其他收入') ORDER BY d.period_end,2

SELECT d.period, CASE d.line_item WHEN '会员（订阅）收入' THEN '会员订阅' WHEN '社交娱乐及其他收入' THEN '社交娱乐' ELSE d.line_item END AS "项目", round((d.yoy * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "同比（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' WHERE d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.yoy IS NOT NULL AND d.period_end >= '2024-01-01' AND d.line_item IN ('会员（订阅）收入', '社交娱乐及其他收入', '营业收入') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

SELECT d.period, d.value AS "毛利率（%）" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' WHERE d.line_item = '毛利率' AND d.period_kind = '单季' AND d.period_end >= vi_today() - interval '3 years' ORDER BY d.period_end

SELECT d.period, d.line_item AS "项目", d.value AS "百万人" FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' WHERE d.period_kind='时点' AND d.period ~ 'Q[1-4]$' AND d.period >= '2024Q1' AND d.line_item IN ('在线音乐月活跃用户', '在线音乐付费用户') ORDER BY d.period_end, 2

SELECT h.year::text AS year,x.item,x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=h.company_id AND co.code='01698.HK' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(d.value) FILTER (WHERE d.line_item='实付本公司股东现金股息') AS div, max(d.value) FILTER (WHERE d.line_item='现金回购支出') AS buyback FROM vi_disclosed d WHERE d.company_id=h.company_id AND d.period=h.year::text AND d.period_kind='全年') r ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('归母净利润',h.np_parent),('实付现金股息',r.div),('现金回购',r.buyback)) x(item,amount) WHERE h.year>=2020 AND x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year,x.item

SELECT h.year, x.item, x.amount FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('经营现金流', h.cfo), ('资本开支', h.capex)) x(item, amount) WHERE x.amount IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year, x.item

SELECT h.year::text AS year, x.item AS "项目", x.v AS "亿元" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = h.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('现金储备', h.cash), ('带息负债', h.interest_debt)) x(item, v) WHERE h.year >= 2019 UNION ALL SELECT d.period, CASE WHEN d.line_item LIKE '现金%' THEN '现金储备' ELSE '带息负债' END, d.value FROM vi_disclosed d JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = d.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' WHERE d.period = '2026Q2' AND (d.line_item LIKE '现金%' OR d.line_item LIKE '带息负债%') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT h.year::text AS year,round((h.payout*100)::numeric,1) AS "%" FROM vi_fin_history h JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id=h.company_id AND co.code='01698.HK' WHERE h.year>=2020 AND h.payout IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.year
SELECT o.obs_date,o.value AS 股价 FROM vi_obs_current o JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.price_metric_id=o.metric_id AND co.code='01698.HK' ORDER BY o.obs_date
SELECT f.dimension AS "维度", f.score AS "评分" FROM vi_fit_score_base f JOIN vi_company_base co ON co.id = f.company_id AND co.code = '01698.HK' ORDER BY f.sort, f.id
